invitation.title: Dear friends and family!
invitation.body: With great joy we invite you to share with us one of the most important days of our lives. This day will be filled with love, laughter and countless memories — and we truly want you to be by our side. Please confirm your attendance and follow the updates on this website — here you will find all the details about the program, location and dress code.

items.title: Meeting of the groom and the bride
items.desc: Gathering of guests, a touching meeting of the couple, getting to know each other and getting into the festive mood

items.title: Ceremony
items.desc: Get your handkerchiefs ready for a touching moment

items.title: Arrival at the restaurant
items.desc: We mingle in the welcome zone, take our seats and get ready for a delicious meal

items.title: Party start
items.desc: Fun awaits us, a wonderful host, contests and a great mood

items.title: Cake
items.desc: We hope and know that you will still have the energy for the festive cake and dancing that follows

footer.follow: follow the website, news and information will be updated
